native_images.name: notebook_tabs_hidden_2.png

native_images.name: manage_notes.png
native_images.finding: 640x420 shared editor: notes/source tabs; notes blue-selected; first line/second text and caret; readable add, edit current name, delete current note, copy, paste, copy URLs, cog, apply/cancel. native_images.name: note-hover-copy.png

test_evidence.description: Actual Options private edits, cancelled retained Apply no write, accepted Apply/reopen and defining editor cursor consumer.

Recorded copy/hover output, model staged persistence and concurrent-field preservation.
